title: How many people still live without electricity?
subtitle: Guess how many people still live without electricity, then a second question: where they live, and the country that switched on 420 million.
form: ask on a scale (number line), then a multiple-choice quiz
notes: OWID/World Bank 2024: 657 M (shown as ≈ 660 M) without electricity; 1.34 bn in 2000 (marker '2000: 1.3 bn' with a 'halved' arrow); India 420 M (2000) → ~1.5 M (2024) drawn as two bars; Sub-Saharan Africa 579 M drawn as a globe + '≈ 580 M' after the quiz and again at the close. Left: the scale's ticks, numbers and 'You' are small — the scale element has no size option (font_size is ignored).
